title: Quant artifact signing, staging matrix, and performance sentry playbook
creator: Priya Raman
description: Problem: We currently accept quantized model artifacts (INT8/GPTQ/AWQ/FP8) with ad-hoc validation and loose provenance. This creates two risks: regressions slip into production because staging matrices are inconsistent, and customers can’t rely on pinned artifacts because there is no cryptographic signing or immutable manifest. Goal: Build an operational playbook and automation layer that enforces artifact signing, a repeatable staging matrix (combinations of model versions, quant profiles, hardware families, and sequence-length buckets), and a 'performance sentry' that gates promotion based on telemetry-driven regression signals. The system should be compatible with our Dedicated and Private deployment modes and integrate with existing CI, the quant profile registry, and the runtime canary hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Artifact bundle format defined: model weights + quant profile + metadata manifest + signature
Automated signing step added to quant-publish CI; published bundles are immutable and referenceable by SHA256
Staging matrix enumerator generates deterministic test matrix for a given bundle (3 hardware families x 4 sequence buckets x 2 batch policies)
Performance sentry runs a predefined eval suite and publishes pass/fail plus delta metrics to the canary dashboard
Promotion workflow prevents pinning to production unless the sentry reports no high-severity regressions and a manual approver signs off
Rollout steps produce an audit log entry with signer, bundle SHA, and canary run ID for compliance
tasks: Design artifact bundle schema and signing protocol (PKI or HSM-backed)
Add signing stage to quant-profile CI pipeline (integration with KMS)
Implement staging matrix generator service and OR-logic for compatible permutations
Wire performance sentry to existing telemetry ingest (token-level latency, top-k accuracy, regression deltas)
Create UI in Console for bundle details, sentinel results, and promotion actions
Draft runbook for on-call to respond to sentry regressions and rollback pin operations
Add e2e smoke tests that exercise bundle publish -> canary -> promotion flow

notes: Trade-offs considered: we avoided embedding full model weights in the signed bundle to keep storage small; instead we sign an immutable pointer + provenance metadata plus a content-addressable manifest. This limits some air-gapped workflows; if a customer requires an all-in-one tarball we will add an 'exportable signed bundle' variant in a follow-up. We also chose to enforce conservative sentry thresholds initially to reduce false negatives at the cost of more manual reviews.
